description: This file defines API routes for managing videos in a FastAPI web application. It includes endpoints for listing videos, retrieving video details, uploading videos, and streaming video content. The code handles filesystem interactions for storing videos and metadata, processes subtitle files, and supports HTTP range requests for streaming.

methods.name: Optional[int] _parse_id_from_stem(stem: str)
methods.description: Parses a numeric ID from the beginning of a filename stem.

methods.name: dict _read_json(path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the filesystem.

methods.name: None _write_json(path: Path, data: dict)
methods.description: Writes a dictionary as JSON to a specified path.

methods.name: tuple[Optional[datetime],Optional[datetime]] _fs_times(p: Path)
methods.description: Retrieves creation and modification times of a filesystem path.

methods.name: List[SubtitleOut] _collect_subtitles_for_video(video_id: int, request: Optional[Request])
methods.description: Collects and sorts subtitle files associated with a specific video ID.

methods.name: list_videos( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search string to filter by title"), )
methods.description: API endpoint to list all available videos with optional filtering.

methods.name: get_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve detailed information for a specific video.

methods.name: upload_video( title: str = Query(..., description="Title for the uploaded video"), description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional description"), file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Binary video file to upload"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: API endpoint to upload a new video file and create its metadata.

methods.name: stream_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video to stream"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: API endpoint to stream video content, supporting HTTP Range requests.

ctags.signature: ( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search string to filter by title"), )

ctags.signature: ( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video to stream"), request: Request = None, )
